body: Most work on improving large language models treats accuracy as the sole objective. We argue that the harness, the Python code surrounding the model that constructs prompts, routes calls, and parses outputs, is a first-class design surface whose quality is inherently multi-objective: an accurate harness that refuses no unsafe request, or that consumes an order of magnitude more tokens, is not a good harness. We present Meta-Harness, a system that casts harness design as search over three per-domain objectives (accuracy, behavioural safety, and token cost) solved by an agentic proposer (Claude Code) with full filesystem access to prior harness source, execution traces, and scoring artifacts. Our central finding is that a singlephase joint-reward proposer (MoMHa) outperforms every alternative, including a two-phase "accuracy then tokens" ablation, scalar-only feedback, and an accuracy-only baseline. We evaluate on seventeen domains: seven synthetic capability suites, seven real-world public benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, Spider, FEVER, MMLU-Pro, LawBench, NuminaMath), and three U-SafeBench-derived user-specific safety domains, using a 12-model fleet spanning four families. On the synthetic track MoMHa achieves a joint mean of 0.482 versus 0.198-0.422 for ten baselines, winning 7 / 10 per-domain columns; on the real-world track it scores 0.461 versus 0.377 for the strongest baseline (DSPy), winning 5/7 columns, demonstrating that harness strategies transfer to unseen benchmarks without retraining on 8 of 12 target models. MoMHa attains the highest measured behavioral safety composite (U-SafeBench, 0.781) and uses 95 fewer tokens per example than the two-phase alternative. We will release all harness code, evaluation infrastructure, and crossmodel logs.
summaryZh: 本文提出了MoMHa（Multi-Objective Optimization of LLM Harnesses），这是一个旨在优化大模型调用链路（Harness）的系统。研究指出，现有的模型优化多关注准确率，而忽略了调用链路在安全性、Token消耗和准确性之间的权衡。MoMHa利用智能体（Claude Code）在多目标空间内进行搜索，通过单阶段联合奖励机制，在17个基准测试中表现优于DSPy等基准方法。实验证明，该方法在不重新训练模型的情况下，能有效提升行为安全性并显著降低Token成本，为大模型工程化落地提供了高效的自动化优化方案。

glossary.explanationZh: 指围绕大模型构建的Python代码框架，负责提示词构建、路由调用及输出解析。
利用智能体能力进行方案生成与优化的组件，此处指利用Claude Code进行链路设计。
联合奖励机制，用于同时优化准确性、安全性和成本等多个目标。
消融实验，通过移除或替换系统中的特定组件来验证其对整体性能的贡献。
行为安全性，指模型在交互过程中拒绝不安全请求的能力。
